newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybeans mostly down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybeans mostly down on profit-taking.

text.p: Most Shanghai soybean futures contracts ended down on Monday on profit-taking, traders said.
The most active September 1997 contract ended at an intraday low of 3,383 yuan ($408) per tonne, losing 26 yuan. It opened at 3,390 yuan and hit a high of 3,394 yuan per tonne.
May rose 15 to 3,380 yuan per tonne, July fell 36 to 3,368, November 28 to 3,400 and the January 1998 contract 22 to 3,398 yuan.
Combined volume fell to 15,200 tonnes from 20,000 tonnes.
